messages:
alex: incident-bot just paged for p99 on /v1/streaming. Dashboard shows a sudden spike ~3x baseline across eu-west.
incident-bot: [ALERT] real-time p99 latency breach - /v1/streaming (eu-west). breach window started ~00:12 UTC. severity: P1. Pager: @oncall
maria: I'm on it. checking grafana and the live tail now.
jas: grabbing logs + traces, any customer-facing errors? saw some 504s in the last minute.
sam: yes a few 504s, and streaming stalls - clients reporting stall/resume behavior.
li: Putting runbook link: https://go/infra/runbooks/streaming-latency
li: First quick checks: infra autoscaler, pod restarts, and CPU/GPU saturation.
maria: Grafana: aggregator latency jumps first, then the worker p99. KV cache hit rate dropped by ~60% at the same time.
jas: stack traces show a blocking syscall in the runtime on a subset of hosts (gpu-rt-*)
sam: Are we hitting a new model rollout? routing shows a canary of model-x-quantized in eu-west.
alex: yes, rollout started 00:05 UTC. possible compatibility regression with streaming kernel.
maria: mitigation plan: 1) pause canary 2) fallback routing to previous variant 3) scale up pool 4) enable prefix cache aggressively
jas: pausing rollout now -> command: /deploy pause model-x-quantized canary
sre-bot: deploy: canary pause request accepted (req 8872). current traffic will be drained in 30s.
sam: routing switch to model-x-v2 (stable) in progress, updating weight to 100% for eu-west.
li: scaling workers +2 in eu-west GPU pool to absorb burst.
alex: enabling aggressive prefix/KV cache: cache policy -> "aggressive" for /v1/streaming. note: doubles memory.
maria: after routing change p99 dropped ~45% within 60s. KV cache hit rate recovering slowly.
jas: logs show fewer stall traces post-switch. still seeing a small tail at p99 ~1.5x baseline.
sam: customer impact: estimated affected requests ~0.3% of total streaming calls over 3m window. no ongoing errors after fallback.
alex: paging update -> oncall stay with mitigation until stable for 15m. open a postmortem-runbook ticket and assign to model-onboard owners.
li: creating ticket: PM-1034 "streaming p99 regression due to model-x-quantized canary" and assigning to @maria, @jas
maria: will take lead on root cause and follow-up. initial hypothesis: new kernel path + streaming op ordering led to KV cache coldstart and threads blocking on a background compaction syscall.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation applied, monitoring. next update in 10m or sooner if regressions.
alex: thanks team. keep the thread updated if anything new shows up. :thumbsup:
